AggregationTermInResponse.description: Information about the aggregation performed using this term.

description.description: A description of the aggregation term, e.g. for custom terms.

entryTypeId.description: The entry type in the Beacon model on which the data will be aggregated.

id.description:
The aggregation term id, wich could be a
* valued filtering term (`ageAtDiagnosis:<=P17Y`, `NCIT:C8936`) * a concept indicated through its attribute's model path (`biosample.histologicalDiagnosis.id`)
  or corresponding to the `id` of an alphanumeric filter
* a custom value
TODO: In principle those different formats could be bound to specific types: * valued filtering term => `count` * concept => `distribution` * custom => `report`

label.description: A short label, e.g. "preferred Label" in the case of an ontology term.

type.description: The type of aggregation object that will be returned for this term. Please see `beaconAggregationResults` for definitions.

description: Aggregation terms and concepts supported for this Beacon.

examples.description: count of individuals with an age at diagnosis younger than 18 years
